moon_mons_mouton.name: Mons Mouton Plateau (Lunar South Pole)
moon_mons_mouton.description: A high, mountainous plateau near the Moon's south pole. NASA lists it as one of the candidate regions for the Artemis III landing.

facts.label: Artemis III
facts.value: One of nine candidate landing regions announced by NASA (Oct 2024)

earth_cannot_simulate: Hard vacuum — no air for convective cooling, no wind
Radiation environment (no magnetic field or atmosphere)
Lunar regolith: sharp, electrostatically charged dust

mars_gale.name: Gale Crater (Curiosity rover site)
mars_gale.description: A large crater with a flat floor and a tall central mountain, where the Curiosity rover has driven since 2012. Its mountain holds salts such as gypsum.

facts.label: Gypsum link to Earth
facts.value: Gale was chosen partly because its central mound is thought to hold gypsum; Cuatro Ciénegas is a gypsum-rich analog
